name: CPN Retail Growth Leasehold REIT
summary: CPN Retail Growth Leasehold REIT was established from the conversion of CPN Retail Growth Leasehold Property Fund and received the transfer of assets, liabilities and obligations from the Fund on 1 December 2017. The Trust was a specific closed-end real estate investment trust with an indefinite term. The Trust was registered on 29 November 2017 with registered capital of Baht 29,653.38 million. CPN Retail Growth Leasehold REIT was established in 2005 and was incorporated in Thailand.
